findings.evidence: A handoff is a markdown file in `<project>/.claude/handoffs/` named `YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS-<slug>.md` that lets a fresh agent continue without rediscovering context.
findings.fix: Drop the opening definition sentence (the model already knows a handoff file is a context transfer) and keep the filename rule, the `$SKILL_DIR` invocation rule and the `--help`/`--json` contract; record the sentence in docs/audit/recovery/session-handoff/record.md.

findings.evidence: The scanner only matches quoted assignments (`api_key = "..."`), any `scheme://user:password@` URL ... Unquoted assignments pass as clean, so check them by hand
findings.fix: Add the two scanner misses the agent will not infer: (1) a URL password containing `/` is not flagged (`user:p/ass@host` never reaches `@`); (2) Slack `xox[baprs]-` requires a hyphen immediately after the prefix, so a real `xoxc-` token is not flagged. Keep the existing unquoted-assignment warning.

Delete the Table of Contents (lines 5-25). The template is one short file loaded only when a section's purpose is unclear; the heading list adds a second copy of headings the agent is about to read. Record the removal.

findings.evidence: `git cat-file -e '<baseline>^{commit}'` checks the commit exists; if it is gone (a different clone, a pruned or rewritten history), find the old tip with `git reflog` or ask the user.
findings.fix: Split the two causes the skill already names: a different clone has no reflog for that commit, so ask the user for the old tip; use `git reflog` only when this checkout's history was pruned or rewritten. Apply the same split to the Baseline ancestry diverged bullet.

findings.evidence: "assertions":["Includes a command using `scripts/create_handoff.py` with a task slug."
findings.fix: Change the four command assertions that require a bare `scripts/<name>.py` path so they accept `python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/<name>.py"`, the form SKILL.md line 14 says is the one that resolves. Keep asserting the script name, slug, and validate-until-READY behavior.

Replace that negative with a near-miss that shares the domain but is out of scope, for example editing the handoff template inside this repository rather than saving a coding session. Keep the other negatives.

findings.evidence: So missing files and deleted recommended headings alone can reach NEEDS_WORK: 4 missing files plus all 6 headings deleted scores 68.
findings.fix: State the interaction the arithmetic hides: a missing required section is also a missing recommended section, so the penalties stack (one required heading gone is -10 and -2). Note that files_missing in --json is capped at 5, so a longer missing list is not the full penalty set.

findings.evidence: Referenced files resolve against the project root and the handoff's directory only.
findings.fix: Say that a chain link written as `./<file>.md` is stored with the `./` and reported missing even when the predecessor sits in the handoff directory (validate_handoff.py extract_file_references; test_deleted_predecessor_link_is_reported_by_validation_and_staleness). Tell the agent to strip a leading `./` before treating the warning as a real missing file.
